title: PUNJAB DEVELOPMENT OF CITIES AMENDMENT ACT 2006

sections.shortTitle: PUNJAB DEVELOPMENT OF CITIES AMENDMENT ACT 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PUNJAB STATUTES
PUNJAB
STATUTES
ACT XVI OF 2006
PUNJAB DEVELOPMENT OF CITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2006
An Act further to amend the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976
[Gazette of Punjab, Extraordinary, 2nd November, 2006]
No.PAP-Legis-2(45)/2006/879,
dated 2-11-2006.---The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Bill 2006,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 11th October,
2006, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 28th October, 2006, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 (XIX of
1976), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.--(1) This Act
may be cited as the Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Act, 2006.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Area" shall be substituted by the words "controlled area".

"(n) `Town Municipal Officer' means town Municipal Officer of the

jurisdiction of the Authority;"

and (p) shall be inserted--
"(o) `Town Nazim' means Nazim of the Town Municipal Administration whose area or

means Nazim of the concerned City District
Government."

An Act further to amend the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976

dated 2-11-2006.---The Punjab Development of Cities (Amendment) Bill 2006,
having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab on 11th October,
2006, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on 28th October, 2006, is
hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the Punjab.
Whereas it is
expedient further to amend the Punjab Development of Cities Act, 1976 (XIX of
1976), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
7. Amendment in
section 30 of Act XIX of 1976.---(1)
In the said Act, section 30 shall be substituted by the following:--
"30. Budget.--(1) The Authority shall at such time as may be
prescribed, prepare an annual budget statement for the next financial year,
showing the estimated receipts and expenditures of the Authority and its
agencies and shall submit the same through the City District Government to the Zila Council for approval.
(2) After approval
of the budget statement, the same shall be reflected in the budget of the City
District Government.
(3) If the Zila Council does not approve or modify the budget
statement within sixty days of its receipt the budget statement as prepared by
the Authority shall be deemed to be the approved budget statement.
